title_en: Minecraft Announces the Sift Dimension Is Coming to Java & Bedrock Edition in 2027
summary_en: Minecraft developer Mojang has announced that the Sift is coming to Java and Bedrock Edition in 2027 — the game's first new dimension in over 14 years.
body_en:
Minecraft developer Mojang has announced that the Sift is coming to Java and Bedrock Edition in 2027 — the game's first new dimension in over 14 years.
As revealed at Minecraft LIVE September 2026, the Sift, which had been announced for upcoming dungeon crawler Minecraft Dungeons 2, is also coming to Minecraft Java & Bedrock Edition next year. It joins the Overworld, The Nether, and The End as Minecraft’s official fourth dimension.
The Sift is a mysterious new dimension with distinct environments, inhabitants, dangers and gameplay.
For more, check out everything announced at Minecraft LIVE .
